The '''1969–70 Cypriot First Division''' was the 31st season of the Cypriot top-level [[Association football|football]] league.

==Overview==
It was contested by 12 teams, and [[EPA Larnaca FC]] won the championship.  [[Olympiakos Nicosia]] participated in the [[1969–70 Alpha Ethniki|Greek championship]] as the previous year's champions. They finished in 17th position.
